notes:
## Changes
- Dashboard: the figures come first. The filters open from a Filters button as a panel over the right of the page, as the folder and scene filters do (Ctrl+Shift+F opens it, Esc closes it). Filters in use show beside the button as chips you can remove one at a time, and "Showing 447 of 100,000 scenes" sits in its own panel on the right.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
